Frequently Asked Questions — Demolition Contractors Equipment Hire in Blue Mountains

How does BuildHire compare to large corporate hire companies?

BuildHire is purpose-built for working contractors, not corporate accounts. Our pricing is fixed and published online, our booking is instant, and we specialise in excavators and earthmoving equipment.

Can I get a 1-day hire from BuildHire?

Yes. BuildHire offers 1-day minimum hire on all equipment. Many corporate hire companies require 3–5 day minimums for earthmoving equipment.

What size excavator is best for residential demolition?

For residential demolition, a 3.5T or 5.5T excavator is most effective. The 5.5T provides more reach and bucket force for breaking up concrete slabs and masonry.

Do I need a licence to operate an excavator for demolition?

For excavators 3 tonnes and above, a High Risk Work Licence (HRWL) for earthmoving plant is required in NSW.
